steps.title: Start a new round
steps.text: Guess the hidden number using the lifetime dial. The curve is generated from your estimate; it is not fitted to measured data. Press Restart when you are ready to replace the current round.

await.hint: Press Restart in the game header.

steps.title: Read the controls
steps.text: Left/Right changes the estimate, Q/E changes it by ten and Enter or Space submits. You can also click the plot and lower footer. Help explains the turns, hints and sound.

await.hint: Press Help in the game header.

steps.title: Check the fresh round
steps.text: Close Help, then press Restart once more. Check that the guess history is empty and the dial is back at 50 with a newly generated hidden target. The guide waits for your click; it never presses a control for you.

await.hint: Press Restart in the game header and inspect the reset round.
